title: 凯尔·罗达：中国科技股被低估？AI叙事或成催化剂
speaker: Kyle Roder

segments.en: I think we need a catalyst for narrative. I mean, if you really look at what has driven Chinese equities and Hong Kong equities incidentally as well over the last year or so is that we need to see evidence from some of those companies that can deliver growth opportunities, which is effectively the artificial intelligence names in China, whether they, you know, be Tencent or Alibaba, we have another deep seek moment, where it sparks some kind of rotation out of, you know, those kind of leading arguably richly valid, but not that richly valid tech names in the United States.
segments.zh: 我们需要叙事催化剂。过去一年驱动中国和香港市场的，是那些能提供增长机会的公司，主要是中国的AI企业，比如腾讯、阿里巴巴。我们需要另一个“DeepSeek时刻”，引发资金从美国估值过高的科技股轮动出来。

segments.en: And the drag is some of that capital back into China and Hong Kong. That's really what's missing at the moment, but if you do look at valuations and where sentiment is at, sentiment's pretty positive still in US tech names. The Chinese tech and Asia tech, well not Asia tech, Chinese tech in particular has under performed recently. There is, I think, a very strong argument to suggest that two cheap, two oversold and this might be a good time to kind of rotate a little bit out of the winners into those other companies in China, which will benefit effectively from the same team.
segments.zh: 资金回流中国和香港市场正是目前所缺失的。但看估值和情绪，美国科技股情绪仍然积极，而中国科技股近期表现落后。我认为有充分理由认为它们过于便宜、超卖，现在可能是从赢家轮动到中国公司的好时机，它们将从同一趋势中受益。

segments.en: Doesn't worry you that we're seeing even on the industrial front, they don't seem to be benefiting from perhaps the AI exports boom with this dip in industrial profit. It shows that there's the decoupling going on that we've seen for quite some time here, that we have a ecosystem, an AI ecosystem led by the United States and that filters through to South Korea and some other parts of Asia. And then the other part of the, you know, sort of multipolar block that is building, which is obviously the Chinese AI, Chinese AI ecosystem, which is becoming decoupling from the supply chains and isn't directly benefiting from the flow and effects from a huge investment boom in the United States.
segments.zh: 工业利润下滑表明，中国并未从AI出口繁荣中受益。这显示了我们长期以来看到的脱钩：美国主导的AI生态系统惠及韩国等亚洲地区，而中国AI生态系统正在与供应链脱钩，并未直接受益于美国的大规模投入。

segments.en: And that kind of, again, AI valuation inflation, I suppose you could say, or increasing multiples that are happening in assets in the United States. So the fact that yes, the industrial activity is where it shows that, you know, China is perhaps behind the curve in some respects when it comes to that part of the AI trade, but also it can't be disentangled to from what is still a very, very anemic Chinese growth story, a structural story in China as well that's being held down, you know, very much by this kind of balance sheet normalization across the private sector.
segments.zh: 这再次体现了美国资产的AI估值膨胀。工业活动显示中国在AI交易方面可能落后，但这与中国疲弱的增长故事和结构性因素密不可分，后者受到私人部门资产负债表正常化的压制。
